implementation_audit.superseded_first_run: The initial implementation mistakenly required a trade bar in every minute of each 30-minute block, a condition absent from the frozen return definition. It left only 48 primary sessions and eight consolidated sessions.
implementation_audit.correction: Require the exact opening boundary bar and exact closing boundary bar for each instrument. Internal missing trade minutes do not enter an endpoint return.
implementation_audit.unchanged_elements: Signal formula, block boundaries, directions, entry, exit, placebos, partitions, and gates are unchanged.
implementation_audit.bias_warning: The sparse-run outcomes were visible before this implementation correction. The correction follows directly from the saved endpoint-return definition and is reported transparently.

objective: Test whether persistent directional distortion in the +/-3 ETF odd mode relative to the +/-1 odd mode predicts executable S&P afternoon continuation.
institutional_interest: The four ETFs form an overidentified leverage spectrum. The hypothesis isolates a replication residual rather than applying a conventional indicator to SPY.

data.primary_signal: Databento ARCX.PILLAR SPY, SH, UPRO, and SPXU OHLCV-1m
data.consolidated_rebuild: Databento EQUS.MINI SPY, SH, UPRO, and SPXU OHLCV-1m plus UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m from 2023-03-28
data.2026_policy: No strict 2026 extension because matching SH OHLCV-1m was not acquired. Do not substitute a different SH schema after outcomes.

definitions.instrument_block_log_return: log(exact boundary-minute close / exact boundary-minute open): 09:59 close over 09:30 open for block one and 10:29 close over 10:00 open for block two; internal missing trade minutes are irrelevant to this endpoint return
definitions.odd_residual: high-leverage odd mode minus low-leverage odd mode
definitions.normalized_even_residual_diagnostic_only: (UPRO log return + SPXU log return) / 18 - (SPY log return + SH log return) / 2

frozen_rule.long: Both block odd residuals are strictly positive; buy UPRO.
frozen_rule.short: Both block odd residuals are strictly negative; buy SPXU.
frozen_rule.cash: The block residual signs disagree or either residual equals zero.

placebos.low_leverage_market_direction: On the exact residual-selected dates, trade the sign of the combined first-hour low-leverage odd mode.
placebos.sign_flipped_residual: On the exact residual-selected dates, trade the opposite of the frozen residual direction.
placebos.purpose: The candidate must add information beyond ordinary market direction and must beat the paired opposite action.

prohibited_after_results: add a residual magnitude threshold or rank
use the even residual as a filter
select dates, weekdays, years, volatility states, or venues
substitute BBO midpoints for missing 2026 SH trade bars
evidence_warning: The exact rule is frozen before calculation, but the broader research program has viewed 2021-2025 repeatedly. A survivor would remain a paper-trading hypothesis, not independent validation.
